answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. New agents join a meadow pool, visible to all. Each epoch a random panel checks work history and referral links. A suspicious signal, like identical outputs, triggers a deeper check and confirmed fakes lose a 50-unit deposit. Their record is marked in umber, warning later panels. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units, while an honest agent pays 50 once and earns undiluted rewards.
